mcp-inventory.name: get_item
mcp-inventory.description: Retrieve a single inventory item by its SKU, including quantity on hand and warehouse location.

mcp-inventory.name: list_items
mcp-inventory.description: List inventory items, optionally filtered by warehouse or category.

mcp-inventory.name: search_items
mcp-inventory.description: List inventory items, optionally filtered by warehouse, category, or keyword.

mcp-inventory.name: update_stock
mcp-inventory.description: Adjust the quantity on hand for an inventory item by SKU. Use a negative delta to remove stock.

mcp-billing.name: get_invoice
mcp-billing.description: Retrieve a single invoice by invoice ID, including line items and payment status.

mcp-billing.name: list_invoices
mcp-billing.description: List invoices for a customer, optionally filtered by status or date range.

mcp-billing.name: get_user
mcp-billing.description: Get the billing profile for a customer, including payment method and billing address.

mcp-billing.name: get_users
mcp-billing.description: List all customers with their billing profiles. Supports pagination.
